speaker: john_heminges
text: Before anyone spends a triumph, the boxes. I have them here, and I will say the figure once. Twelve pound thirteen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve pound thirteen. The second of October was eleven pound six, for Richard. This is above it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is above it. It is the year's best house. The share is forty shillings. I am saying both. I am not making the one out of the other.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Forty shillings is a man's share, John, and twelve pound thirteen is a house. If you will not do the arithmetic I will not do it for you in a triumph. I know what a false sum sounds like. It sounds like a jig that has been promised an extra verse.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eight forties are sixteen pound. Twelve pound thirteen is two hundred and fifty-three shillings. Sixteen pound does not come out of two hundred and fifty-three shillings. So I will not say that the share is the box divided. The share is forty shillings. The box is twelve pound thirteen. A man who wants a third figure can go and invent one at his own table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No third figure. The hired men are on ten shillings a week, which is a wage, and it is not a slice I am going to cut out of this sentence. Humphrey's copying was extra work. It was not priced. I am not pricing it now out of a good house.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the money can sit there, ugly and honest. The five words were enough, Will. I dislike them still, and I died on them, and the yard did not ask me for a sixth.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I came in under. I held. I am not discussing the doublet, and I am not discussing the end. The end was yours and his. The note was mine, and it stayed mine.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Three stops, and one left in the pocket, as I was told on Wednesday. The yard lived. I will take the forty shillings and I will not pretend I have counted the box on my fingers.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I've no line, masters. I never watch. The lower gallery was full before one. A church hat, with a girl beside her, sat straight through it and went down the stair when it was done. I have nothing clever to put after that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing clever is the right length. She had never been inside. If she speaks at the door, the door can have it. I am not asking the stair for a verdict.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Church hat noted, and not entered as a sum. I do not take a widow's seat out of a gatherer's story and call it accountancy. Twelve pound thirteen. Forty shillings. Will, count yours into the pouch when you are home. Do not count the coffer at me.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One line more, and the fan set down. That is my triumph, and it is cheaper than John's. The slate was empty before today. It is empty after. I call that manners.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The hall was not in the play, and the price of a hall was not in the play. Good. I am going to Holywell to sleep like a man who was refused, and rightly.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am going to be quiet. Under the note is a morning's work as well as an afternoon's. I would like a Sunday in which nobody asks me to prove it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The stair is clear. I never watch. You may all go home richer than October and none the wiser, which is the usual end of a good house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richer than the second of October, by the boxes, and forty shillings in the pouch. I will not make them agree. John, thank you for refusing the division. Margery, thank you for having no line. I am for the gate, and then the door.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Rose had a bill. I am not saying what they took. I do not know, and I would not enter it if a gossip brought it to the table.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then the bill across the river is a bill, and our paper is a paper. I have my three stops. I do not need their title to feel paid.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And I do not need a pie, or a speech, or a hand on my collar. I had the note. I am taking the note home.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Take it home, boy, and take the forty shillings with a straight face. The stair is done. I have no second line stored up for the walk.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One line was my whole luxury, Margery. If I had stored a second, John would have heard it, and the slate would have woken.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let it sleep. Will, you were flint, and the yard was the better for it. I am not asking again tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then nobody asks again tonight. Twelve pound thirteen stays twelve pound thirteen. Forty shillings stays forty shillings. I am for the moon at the gate, and then a door.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Forty shillings, and the box left as a box. I can carry an ugly honest paper home.
